name: How do I choose the right home improvement contractor?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right home improvement contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor, look for experience, proper licensing, and insurance. Check their portfolio for similar projects and ask for references from past clients. Transparent communication, a clear contract, and a detailed project timeline are also key indicators of a reliable contractor. Get multiple quotes and compare not just price, but also the scope of work and materials proposed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on experience, licensing, insurance, references, clear communication, and a detailed contract.
